# Nateblendz

> Nateblendz is a barber in Tustin, California. Nathan does low, mid and high fades, tapers, haircut designs, eyebrow cleanups and straight-razor beard shaping. Appointments are booked online through Booksy.

## Key facts
- Location: 13132 Newport Ave, Floor 2, Suite 230, Tustin, CA 92780 (per the Tustin Booksy listing, October 2026)
- Services: Haircut; Haircut & Design; Haircut & Eyebrows; Haircut & Beard
- Booking, current prices and open times: https://booksy.com/en-us/1163169_nateblendz_barber-shop_103795_tustin
- Website languages: English and Spanish

## Pages
- Home: services, style finder, fade guide, aftercare, rewards, visit info and FAQ
